districtFact: Fort Worth ISD publishes separate traditional, Additional Days School Year (ADSY), Early College High School, and selected program calendars. This page focuses on the traditional districtwide student calendar unless a separate calendar is linked.

districtFaqs.q: Does this calendar cover every Fort Worth ISD school?
districtFaqs.a: No. This page covers FWISD's traditional districtwide student calendar. ADSY campuses, Early College High School at TCC, Alice Carlson ALC, Jo Kelly, and campus-specific events may use different schedules.

districtFaqs.q: Where should families verify Fort Worth ISD calendar updates?
districtFaqs.a: Check the official Fort Worth ISD calendar page before making travel, child care, or school-specific plans. MySchoolDates is independently maintained and is not affiliated with Fort Worth ISD.

districtFaqs.q: Is Fort Worth ISD the same as Dallas ISD?
districtFaqs.a: No. Fort Worth ISD and Dallas ISD are separate school districts with separate calendars. Families with children in both districts should check each district's official calendar.

planningTips.title: Fort Worth ISD Calendar Notes
content: Use the traditional calendar for most FWISD schools, but check the separate ADSY, Early College High School, Alice Carlson ALC, and Jo Kelly calendars if your child attends one of those programs.
Good Friday is a student holiday on March 26, 2027, one week after spring break.
The official 2026–27 traditional calendar lists 175 student days and 78,750 instructional minutes.
